rationale: A is clearer, more compact, and more robust: its pop2 helper avoids the repetitive binary-operation code in B and preserves the stack on underflow, while its token-level definition state supports definitions spanning lines and execution after a semicolon. It also consistently resolves definition bodies at compile time. B needlessly mixes eager and deferred resolution, mutates the stack on two-operand underflow, and assumes each definition occupies a whole line, silently ignoring tokens after its semicolon.
